## Standing operator rules
- Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- `cache-eu-1` must not receive writes; use `cache-eu-3` for staging.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix JPY amounts displaying two decimal places in `ledgerly/money.py` (actual helper path inspected: `ledgerly/billing/money.py`).

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pinning `httpx` to 0.23: broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
- PDF migration: paused/superseded.
- Negative PDF credits: done; focused test passed.
- Shared PDF money formatting: done; 3 tests passed.
- `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`: status unknown.
- Next: `pytest -q tests/test_money.py`

## Recent work
PDF now includes negative credits and uses `format_money()`. Ruff passed. Last inspection found `_page_for_row()` divides row height by `72`, potentially miscalculating page breaks; JPY formatting remains unfixed.
